text: Solverde - Sociedade de Investimentos Turisticos da Costa Verde, S.A. (the casino and hotel group behind the Solverde.pt betting brand) is 93.67% held by its parent company Violas - Sociedade Gestora de Participacoes Sociais, S.A. of Espinho: Solverde's 2025 annual report states the share capital is 6,000,000 shares and that the parent company holds 5,619,964 shares, corresponding to 93.67% of the capital (the remaining 6.33% being 380,036 treasury shares). No state or fund appears among its shareholders.
short: Grupo Solverde is 93.67% held by Violas SGPS (the Manuel Violas family holding).

source.name: Solverde, S.A. Relatorio & Contas 2025, note 15.1 Capital (scanned PDF, p. 77 of the report)
source.quote: sendo representado por 6.000.000 acoes de valor nominal de 5 euros cada, nao quaisquer titulos preferenciais ou privilegiados. A Empresa-Mae, Violas Empresa Gestora acoes Sociais, S.A., detem 5.619.964 acoes, a que corresponde 93,67% do capital
source.note: Scanned PDF without extractable text: the quote was transcribed by hand from the rendered page image (note 15.1 CAPITAL).
